title: Graph Persistence
summary: This module provides mechanisms for persisting the state and execution history of graph runs, supporting both file-based and in-memory storage solutions.

nodes.label: File State Persistence
nodes.title: File State Persistence
nodes.description: Manages the persistence of graph run states and snapshots to a JSON file, ensuring durability and recoverability across sessions.

nodes.label: In-Memory State Persistence
nodes.title: In-Memory State Persistence
nodes.description: Stores graph run states and snapshots in memory, offering fast access for transient or short-lived graph executions.

nodes.label: Base State Persistence
nodes.title: Base State Persistence
nodes.description: An abstract base class defining the common interface for all state persistence implementations, including methods for snapshotting and loading.

groups.label: Persistence Implementations
groups.title: Persistence Implementations
groups.description: Concrete implementations for storing and retrieving graph execution states.
